notes: Proposed: k-means SMOTE (k in {2,20,50,100,250,500}, knn in {3,5,20,inf}, irt in {1,inf}, de in {0,2,#features}); SMOTE knn in {3,5,20}. Classifiers LR, KNN (k 3,5,8), GBM (50,100,200 trees); abstract highlights none, LR listed first, but only KNN has per-dataset plot. Metrics g-mean, F1, AUPRC; best value over grid per metric; evaluation: 5-fold CV repeated five times (p.13; stratification discussed generally on p.10 but not stated for the experiments). All oversamplers balance classes fully. Figure 9 (p.25): false positives of k-means SMOTE as % of SMOTE per dataset (plot), avg 55% reduction.
